create_student: Register a student. Body: name. Returns the student including its id.
create_course: Add a course. Body: name, credits (credit hours, a whole number from 1 to 6). Returns the course including its id. Refused when credits is outside 1 to 6.
record_score: Enter a student's score for a course. Path params: id (the student). Body: course_id, score (whole number from 0 to 100). Entering a score again for the same student and course replaces the old one. Refused when the score is outside 0 to 100 or the course does not exist.
get_results: A student's results. Path params: id (the student). Returns gpa and courses: a list (any order) with one entry per course the student has a score in, each with course_id, score, grade (letter) and grade_point. The grade, grade_point and gpa are computed by the backend using the college's grading scale and GPA rule (see the client).
